nodes.raw: Learning improves when we retrieve a small idea. Memory grows with deliberate practice. This third sentence stays in the source only.

nodes.title: A smaller loop, a stronger memory
nodes.raw: Short retrieval sessions turn saved information into something we can recall. A question is often more useful than another reread. Schedule one small check tomorrow instead of a large review next month.
nodes.summary: Short retrieval sessions turn saved information into something we can recall. A question is often more useful than another reread.

nodes.title: The case for a local-first workspace
nodes.raw: A private workspace makes the boundary around personal data easier to see. Local-first systems can keep the working copy close to its owner. Sync and backup still require explicit design.
nodes.summary: A private workspace makes the boundary around personal data easier to see. Local-first systems can keep the working copy close to its owner.

nodes.title: Design for retrieval, not just storage
nodes.raw: A useful interface helps us ask better questions of saved material. Design choices such as clear titles and focused collections reduce the distance between capturing and learning.
nodes.summary: A useful interface helps us ask better questions of saved material. Design choices such as clear titles and focused collections reduce the distance between capturing and learning.

nodes.title: Connections need a reason
nodes.raw: A knowledge graph is only useful when its edges can be explained. Shared tags are a simple, inspectable rule, but they are not semantic understanding. A system should label that difference.
nodes.summary: A knowledge graph is only useful when its edges can be explained. Shared tags are a simple, inspectable rule, but they are not semantic understanding.

nodes.title: A practical rhythm for spaced practice
nodes.raw: Spaced repetition schedules the next recall attempt after a delay. A difficult review shortens the interval and a successful review gradually extends it. Memory ratings should reflect actual recall.
nodes.summary: Spaced repetition schedules the next recall attempt after a delay. A difficult review shortens the interval and a successful review gradually extends it.

nodes.title: Make AI boundaries visible
nodes.raw: An AI interface should show where model output ends and source evidence begins. Clear attribution helps a reader inspect claims. A deterministic summary is not the same as a language-model summary.
nodes.summary: An AI interface should show where model output ends and source evidence begins. Clear attribution helps a reader inspect claims.

nodes.title: Small data, explicit relationships
nodes.raw: Database relationships describe how records belong together. A graph can reveal related work when every edge has a clear label. Deleting a record should also clean up its dependent references.
nodes.summary: Database relationships describe how records belong together. A graph can reveal related work when every edge has a clear label.

nodes.title: Capture with context and consent
nodes.raw: Privacy starts before information enters a tool. Capture only the text needed for a specific question. A URL alone does not grant permission to scrape personal data or send it to a provider.
nodes.summary: Privacy starts before information enters a tool. Capture only the text needed for a specific question.
